integrity_checks.detail: All 69 fault_ids are globally unique across all three splits. DEV contains NL_01/02, PL_01/02, SD_01/02, RC_01/02, QU_01/02, DF_01, MC_01, CF_00..CF_23. VAL contains DF_02, MC_02, NL_03, PL_03, SD_03, RC_03, CF_24..CF_35. TEST contains QU_03, DF_03, MC_03, CF_36..CF_47. No collisions detected.

All 69 scenarios contain all 13 required fields: fault_id, name, root_cause_service, fault_type, injected_at_t, expected_recovery_t, causal_path, confounded, confounder_description, affected_services, observable_by_rift, split, ground_truth_locked, seed. Note: 'name' is present in all files though not listed in the audit spec — treated as bonus metadata, does not affect PASS.

Every scenario's internal 'split' field matches the file it resides in. All 36 scenarios in development.json carry split='DEVELOPMENT'. All 18 in validation.json carry split='VALIDATION'. All 15 in held_out_test.json carry split='HELD_OUT_TEST'. No cross-contamination via mislabelled internal split values.
ground_truth_locked=true for all 69 scenarios across all three splits. Immutability guarantee is structurally enforced at the data level.
Set intersection of fault_ids across DEVELOPMENT, VALIDATION, and HELD_OUT_TEST is empty. No scenario ID appears in more than one split. Label leakage via ID overlap: none.
manifest.json split_counts: DEVELOPMENT=36, VALIDATION=18, HELD_OUT_TEST=15. Actual n_scenarios in files: development.json=36, validation.json=18, held_out_test.json=15. All match exactly.

Observed counts across all 69 scenarios — NETWORK_LATENCY:3, PACKET_LOSS:3, SERVICE_DEGRADATION:3, RESOURCE_CONTENTION:3, QUEUEING:3, DEPENDENCY_FAILURE:3, MULTI_CAUSE:3, CONFOUNDED:48. Matches manifest by_fault_type exactly.
All 69 scenarios have injected_at_t=60.0. expected_recovery_t values are 300.0, 360.0, 420.0, 480.0, 540.0, or 600.0 — all strictly greater than 60.0. No violations found.

3 non-confounded scenarios have empty causal_path=[]: RC_01 (DEVELOPMENT, seed=43), RC_02 (DEVELOPMENT, seed=44), RC_03 (VALIDATION, seed=45). All three are fault_type=RESOURCE_CONTENTION with root_cause_service=redis_cart. An empty causal_path on a non-confounded scenario is ambiguous — it may be intentional (resource contention propagates implicitly via shared resource rather than a directed service call path) or a generation oversight. Severity: MEDIUM. Does not affect structural integrity but weakens causal path completeness for this fault type. Recommendation: add a comment field or update causal_path to [['redis_cart','cart']] to reflect the observed propagation chain. DO NOT modify existing records; add a generator note.

Trial-2 block (seed=44): NL_02, PL_02, SD_02, RC_02, QU_02 — 5 non-confounded (DF_02 and MC_02 moved to VALIDATION)
CF_00..CF_23: 24 confounded scenarios with unique sequential seeds 42..65

seed_uniqueness_audit.detail: Seeds are NOT unique per scenario. Multiple scenarios within the same trial block share seeds (e.g., NL_01/PL_01/SD_01/RC_01/QU_01/DF_01/MC_01 all have seed=43; NL_02/PL_02/SD_02/RC_02/QU_02 all have seed=44). The manifest states 'each scenario has unique seed derived from manifest seed=42' but seeds are assigned per trial-group, not per scenario. Confounded scenarios (CF_00..CF_47) DO have unique sequential seeds 42..89. Non-confounded scenarios share seeds within their trial block. Severity: LOW — seeds serve as replay anchors; shared seeds within a trial block are consistent with the generation logic (one RNG seed per trial run, not per fault type). However, the manifest claim of per-scenario uniqueness is not accurate for non-confounded scenarios.

notes: One structural FAIL: causal_path is empty for RESOURCE_CONTENTION scenarios (RC_01, RC_02, RC_03). These are non-confounded but have no causal edges recorded. This is likely intentional (shared-resource contention has no directed call-path in the service graph) but violates the audit spec check. Severity: MEDIUM.

One informational WARNING: seed values are not strictly unique per scenario for non-confounded scenarios; they are unique per trial-group. This is consistent with the generator design but inconsistent with the manifest prose description.

All structural integrity properties hold: correct split counts, no duplicate IDs, no cross-split contamination, ground_truth_locked=true throughout, split labels consistent, manifest counts match, fault type distribution matches, recovery times always exceed injection times.

HELD_OUT_TEST was accessed only to verify structural properties (field presence, split labels, ground_truth_locked, fault_id uniqueness). No label values from HELD_OUT_TEST were used for any tuning decision. The audit does not inspect HELD_OUT_TEST ground-truth labels for model selection purposes.
Confounded count in manifest is listed both under 'confounded':48 and under 'by_fault_type.CONFOUNDED':48 — these are consistent.
